author: Mental Outlaw
description:
In this video I discuss how X (the platform formerly known as twitter) sent cease and desist letters to the operators of nitter.net, xcancel, and other various twitter front end alternatives and claimed that scraping twitter and then serving up posts for people to view on other platforms without X's permission is illegal.  At least one Nitter operator is seeking to fight against X's copyright violation claims.
